description: A day-cycle count beyond the 1.1 bound stays valid in a document declaring 1.0, where counts have no upper bound - under the closed date domain the second matching day falls outside it, so the year enumerates the anchor day alone
spec: Versioning - a restriction introduced by a later version never rejects an older document; Correspondence between 1.0 and 1.1 - a count beyond its bound yields the anchor point alone
